name: io.github.tonyyang0504/smartnews_ads-mcp
description: SmartNews Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resume. Every tool maps to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SMARTNEWS_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Developer app id (numeric client id) of an approved SmartNews Ads developer application.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SMARTNEWS_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The developer app's client secret; access tokens (scope ads-manager) last 24 hours and are re-requested automatically.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SMARTNEWS_ADS_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: SmartNews ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).
